Which statement about ethane is correct?
A
It rapidly decolourises aqueous bromine.
B
It does not burn.
C
It forms long-chain compounds called polymers.
D
It only contains single bonds between its atoms.

options.label: C
options.text: It forms long-chain compounds called polymers.

options.label: D
options.text: It only contains single bonds between its atoms.
